name: Orihara Tsumugi
source:
[url=/c66244]Ryouichi's[/url] mother, she is the owner of a sewing shop and her talent is very well known in the region. She has known [url=/c66241]Yuzu[/url] for a long time and keeps telling her son not to miss the opportunity to have a good cook as a future wife.

Since she met [url=/c66240]Airi[/url] and discovered her talents as a tailor, she is proud to see that her son is an immeasurable success and increasingly urges her son to choose one to become his girlfriend.
